primary.$description: Primary text on canvas and surface.

muted.$description: Supporting text with text-plus-shape status cues.

signal.$description: Primary game action and current-context signal; never truth alone.

safe.$description: Supporting success detail; always paired with text.

warning.$description: Supporting withheld or queued-state detail; always paired with text.

danger.$description: Supporting error detail; always paired with text.

system.$description: Platform system family for native dynamic-type compatibility.

body.$description: Readable body copy; native setting may enlarge it.

statement.$description: Shared prompt baseline; content must wrap without losing controls.

minimum.$description: MVP touch-control minimum; verify natively before release.

transition.$description: Optional orientation-only transition; not truth or commit feedback.

contrast.$value: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast target; check rendered native combinations before release.
contrast.$description: Contractual target, not a conformance claim.

truth.$value: Every truth or status state uses words plus a non-color cue.

reducedMotion.$value: Tap-only, no-motion completion is equivalent to the primary round.
